basic_info.description: Welcome to 428 Monterey Blvd - a character-rich home in the heart of San Francisco's vibrant Sunnyside neighborhood. Officially recorded as a 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom, this home lives more like a 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath with a flexible floor plan. The main level offers a bright and airy living room, dedicated dining area, an extended kitchen with direct backyard access, a full bathroom, and a bedroom. Upstairs, the room and loft-style retreat has served as the primary suite  ideal for sleeping, reading, or unwinding  complete with a convenient half bath and sweeping views of southern San Francisco. The basement level provides generous space for storage, creative projects, or future expansion. Built in 1910, the home blends vintage charm with potential for modern updates to make it truly your own. Perfectly positioned just minutes from BART, MUNI, major freeways, Sunnyside Playground, Glen Park Village, Safeway, and local eateries  this is a rare chance to own a single-family home in one of the city's most connected and up-and-coming neighborhoods. Don't miss your opportunity to bring your vision to life in a timeless San Francisco home.
